questions.q_en: On 20th March 2023 it was Monday. What was the day of the week on 20th March 2022?
questions.solution_en:
The year 2022 is not a leap year. It has 1 odd day.

Thus, the day of 20th March 2022 is 1 day before the day on 20th March 2023.

Monday - 1 = Sunday

Hence, on 20th March 2022, it was Sunday.

• X and Y go on a bike ride, starting early morning, facing Sun.

• They approached a cross road at a distance of 1 km.

• X takes left turn and Y goes to the right.

• After travelling for 1 km, Y turns to his right and travels 3 km to reach a village.

So, the village with respect to Y's initial position is in South-west direction.

questions.q_en:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the equation correct?

11 + 10 X 90 ÷ 3 - 120 = 20
questions.solution_en:
We have the original equation as:-

11 + 10 X 90 ÷ 3 - 120 = 20

On checking each option one by one, after interchanging we get:-

Option (a): + and -

11 - 10 X 90 ÷ 3 + 120 = 20

11 - 300 + 120

131 - 300

-169 ≠ 20

LHS is not equal to RHS.

Thus, option (a) is incorrect

Option (b): X and +

11 X 10 + 90 ÷ 3 - 120 = 20

11 X 10 + 30 - 120

110 + 30 - 120

140 - 120

20 = 20

LHS is equal to RHS.

Thus, option (b) is correct

Option (c): ÷ and -

11 + 10 X 90 - 3 ÷ 120 = 20

11 + 10 X 90 - 0.025

11 + 900 - 0.025

911 - 0.025

910.975 ≠ 20

LHS is not equal to RHS.

Thus, option (c) is incorrect

Option (d): ÷ and X

11 + 10 ÷ 90 X 3 - 120 = 20

11 + 0.33 - 120

11.33 - 120

-108.67 ≠ 20

LHS is not equal to RHS.

Thus, option (d) is incorrect
